verdict.rationale: There's evidence of getting-started docs (launch instance, load balancer, object storage, CLI quickstart) and CLI install/config instructions with exact commands (e.g. dnf install), plus a free trial to try it without cost. But there's no evidence of a single unified 'zero to running service in under an hour' quickstart with a full exact command sequence, nor time estimates, nor independent confirmation of onboarding speed. Missing for 10: a consolidated end-to-end quickstart tutorial with all commands shown, explicit time-to-first-deploy claims, and hands-on/community corroboration of a fast first deploy.
